'''Baummu''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Shadola sector/Legends|Shadola sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was violently attacked during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Briera]]. Briera was later known as the "Butcher of Baummu".
